## Change

Explain the problem, the resulting behavior, and any visible interface changes.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Include the platform and compiler for build changes. For a UI change, add a screenshot with any account or private server information removed.

- [ ] The change preserves the public default URL and empty release credentials.
- [ ] Relevant core, HTTP, preview or Retro regression checks pass.
- [ ] New dependencies retain a pinned source hash and their license notices.
- [ ] Runtime packages still start the actual executable without a launcher script.

## Limits

Describe any behavior or platform you could not verify.
